findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子：政府可能對產品課關稅，可能影響公司自供應商取得 AI/HPC 資料中心設備（Helios 建置供應鏈風險含關稅）。
findings.excerpt: Governments have limited or may limit the shipment of products in and out of their jurisdictions or impose tariffs on products, which could negatively impact our ability to receive AI/HPC data center equipment from our suppliers.

findings.claim: 10-K 業務章節：公司須遵守美國及他國經濟制裁（OFAC SDN 含加密地址），為制裁合規而非出口管制/實體清單曝險。
findings.excerpt: We must comply with economic and trade sanctions administered by the United States and other foreign governments in jurisdictions in which we operate.
